title: carduncellus × doumerguei
intro: Carduncellus × doumerguei, commonly known as Spiny Cardoon, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family, resulting from the hybridization of Carduus pycnocephalus and Cynara cardunculus. The Spiny Cardoon has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of digestive issues, inflammation, and as an antispasmodic agent. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Carduncellus × doumerguei include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
